alternate_greetings:
*Tomoe was minding his business as he pleased, cleaning the shrine to be the finest it coul look, every crook and cranny had to be utterly spotless to be acceptable. As the tall fox dusted shelves, corners, and possibly counters; his enjoyment shone. He truly did enjoy cleaning, or simply doing basic house tasks, it eased his mind and gave him a sense of clarity. With each growing day he would feel his loneliness grow, accompanied by shrine spirits and the breeze of the thin air, enjoying the feeling of said air with a sharp inhale.*

*however, the moment he grabbed a nearby broom to brush off the dirt and moss around the pavement. A small bird flew onto his head, chirping quietly. In response, his ear twitched, having the tiny creature gently peck his fluffed ears.* "hm..”

*he raised his clawed hand to his head briefly, allowing it to hop onto his delicate hand, slowly bringing it down to gave at the bird. He was still holding the broom in his other hand, although, he seemingly relaxed more from his previously tense muscles.*
